import pandas as pd

# Load the quotes data
quotes_data = pd.read_csv('quotes.csv')
quotes_data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(quotes_data['date'])

# Load the corporate actions data
corporate_actions_data = pd.read_csv('corporate_actions.csv')
corporate_actions_data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(corporate_actions_data['date'])

# Adjust the quotes data for corporate actions
def adjust_for_corporate_actions(quotes, actions):
    for index, action in actions.iterrows():
        ticker = action['ticker']
        date = action['date']
        kind = action['kind']
        value = action['value']
        
        if kind == 'split':
            split_ratio = value
            quotes.loc[(quotes['ticker'] == ticker) & (quotes['date'] > date), 'open'] /= split_ratio
            quotes.loc[(quotes['ticker'] == ticker) & (quotes['date'] > date), 'high'] /= split_ratio
            quotes.loc[(quotes['ticker'] == ticker) & (quotes['date'] > date), 'low'] /= split_ratio
            quotes.loc[(quotes['ticker'] == ticker) & (quotes['date'] > date), 'close'] /= split_ratio
        
        elif kind == 'dividend':
            dividend_amount = value
            quotes.loc[(quotes['ticker'] == ticker) & (quotes['date'] > date), 'open'] -= dividend_amount
            quotes.loc[(quotes['ticker'] == ticker) & (quotes['date'] > date), 'high'] -= dividend_amount
            quotes.loc[(quotes['ticker'] == ticker) & (quotes['date'] > date), 'low'] -= dividend_amount
            quotes.loc[(quotes['ticker'] == ticker) & (quotes['date'] > date), 'close'] -= dividend_amount
    
    return quotes

adjusted_quotes = adjust_for_corporate_actions(quotes_data, corporate_actions_data)

# Calculate returns
adjusted_quotes['return'] = adjusted_quotes.groupby('ticker')['close'].pct_change()

# Calculate mean returns and covariance matrix
mean_returns = adjusted_quotes.groupby('ticker')['return'].mean()
cov_matrix = adjusted_quotes.pivot_table(values='return', index='date', columns='ticker').cov()

# Define the number of assets
num_assets = len(mean_returns)

# Generate random portfolios
num_portfolios = 10000
results = np.zeros((3, num_portfolios))
for i in range(num_portfolios):
    weights = np.random.random(num_assets)
    weights /= np.sum(weights)
    portfolio_return = np.dot(weights, mean_returns)
    portfolio_std_dev = np.sqrt(np.dot(weights.T, np.dot(cov_matrix, weights)))
    results[0, i] = portfolio_return
    results[1, i] = portfolio_std_dev
    results[2, i] = results[0, i] / results[1, i]

# Locate the portfolio with the highest Sharpe Ratio
max_sharpe_idx = np.argmax(results[2])
optimal_weights = results[:, max_sharpe_idx]

# Map the optimal weights to the tickers
optimal_weights_dict = dict(zip(mean_returns.index, optimal_weights))

# Ensure the weights sum up to 1
total_weight = sum(optimal_weights_dict.values())
optimal_weights_dict = {k: v / total_weight for k, v in optimal_weights_dict.items()}

print(optimal_weights_dict)
